dispatch_model_auto: dispatch a pytorch model across GPU devices using an auto generated device map
dispatch_model_disk_offload: dispatch a model with weights offloaded to disk using a specified offload folder
init_empty_weights_meta: initialize a pytorch model with all parameters on the meta device to save RAM
init_empty_weights_buffers: initialize a model with parameters and buffers on the meta device including buffers
compute_module_sizes: compute the memory size in bytes of each submodule in a pytorch model
